gloss: to take a short break; to have a smoke or a cup of tea

definitions.gloss: to take a short break; to pause for a breather
definitions.explanation: To stop work briefly and relax. {一服|いっぷく} literally means one dose or one serving, so the break is typically accompanied by a cigarette or a cup of tea — often implied even when not stated.

examples.japanese: ⟦ちょっと→ちょっと：00595_chotto⟧{一服|いっぷく}しよう。
⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{合間|あいま}→合間：05708_aima⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{一服|いっぷく}する。
examples.english: I take a breather between tasks.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昼食|ちゅうしょく}→昼食：01616_chuushoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧あと、⟦{庭|にわ}→庭：02239_niwa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}て→出る：00513_deru⟧{一服|いっぷく}する⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{習慣|しゅうかん}→習慣：01429_shuukan⟧だ。
examples.english: Going out to the garden for a smoke after lunch is my father's habit.

examples.japanese: ⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{全部|ぜんぶ}→全部：02888_zenbu⟧⟦{運|はこ}び→運ぶ：01088_hakobu⟧⟦{終|お}えて→終える：02019_oeru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦お{茶|ちゃ}→お茶：00576_ocha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}んで→飲む：00322_nomu⟧{一服|いっぷく}した。
examples.english: After carrying in all the luggage, we all had tea and took a break.

notes:
Slightly old-fashioned and warm in tone, and strongly associated with smokers, though it is used for any short rest. ⟦{一服|いっぷく}→一服：17697_ippuku⟧ also works as a plain noun.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{一服|いっぷく}→一服：17697_ippuku⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧: to take a breather
- ⟦{一服|いっぷく}→一服：17697_ippuku⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧: to light a cigarette
- ⟦ここ→ここ：00961_koko⟧ら⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{一服|いっぷく}→一服：17697_ippuku⟧: time for a break about now

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{休憩|きゅうけい}→休憩：00262_kyuukei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to take a break — neutral and general; the word used at work or school
- ⟦{一息|ひといき}つく→一息つく：19319_hitoikitsuku⟧: to catch one's breath — emphasizes relief after finishing something demanding
